title: Coherent pullback tensor associativity on K-flat triples
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbb Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$, and $f:X\to Y$. Use the coherent coefficient-sequence modules, derived inverse image $F$, and normalized tensor comparison $\mu$ of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], and the K-flat tensor models of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. For three K-flat cochain complexes $A,B,C$ of coefficient-sequence module sheaves on $Y$, put $M=Q_Y(A)$, $N=Q_Y(B)$, and $P=Q_Y(C)$. Then $F(\alpha^Y_{M,N,P})\,\mu_{M,N\otimes P}\,(1\otimes\mu_{N,P})=\mu_{M\otimes N,P}\,(\mu_{M,N}\otimes1)\,\alpha^X_{FM,FN,FP}$. Composition is in traversal order. No boundedness, termwise flatness, constructibility, or invertibility hypothesis is imposed. This statement concerns the displayed localized K-flat triples; extending it by naturality to arbitrary derived objects is separate.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product, total tensor construction and its reassociation; Tag 07A2, lemma-tensor-product-K-flat.

proof.text: Use coefficientTotalTensor_isKFlat for both intermediate total tensors and pullbackTensorSequenceGood for the inverse images. Apply the normalization of pullbackTensorSystemComparison to the four pairs (A,B), (B,C), (A tensor B,C) and (A,B tensor C).

In each triple degree, the cochain comparison takes the adjunction-unit image of a pure tensor to the tensor of the unit images. Along either associativity path, (x tensor y) tensor z is therefore sent to f*x tensor (f*y tensor f*z). Reassociation introduces no permutation or extra Koszul sign. The same equality respects all three differential summands and sequence restrictions. Tensor sheafification, pure-tensor extensionality and total coproduct injections detect equality of the chain maps. Apply the derived quotient, insert the specified tensor representative and exact inverse-image factorization maps, and cancel their naturality squares. The remaining reassociation maps are the displayed derived associators.

theorem completedPullbackTensor_associativity_representatives {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (A B C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (hA : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) A)
    (hB : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) B)
    (hC : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) C) :
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj A
    let N := DerivedCategory.Q.obj B
    let P := DerivedCategory.Q.obj C
    (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.monoidal.associator M N P).hom ≫
      (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
        (M,(pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.obj (N,P)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (N,P))) =
    (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M,N),P) ≫
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (M,N)) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.monoidal.associator
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj M)
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj N)
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj P)).hom
